data.exact_reserve_text: During 2018, gross ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2016 & prior) increased marginally by $0.6m (approximately $0.2m net). However, this is the result of a significant reduction in premium of $35.6m gross (approx. $14.0m net), offset by an increase of $25.1m gross (approx. $10.0m net) due to underlying claims deterioration. The drivers of the adverse experience are, most notably, from the Professional classes. There was also adverse experience on Aviation (Aerospace and General Aviation), Accident & Health and Aon Client Treaty, offset by favourable experience in Technical risks.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse claims development on older underwriting years, particularly in the Professional Indemnity class 2014/2015, contributed to prior year deterioration.

prior_year_events.event_name: Aviation adverse experience (Aerospace and General Aviation)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse experience on Aviation (Aerospace and General Aviation) contributed to prior year deterioration.
Adverse experience on Accident & Health contributed to prior year deterioration.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were $648.329m. During 2018 gross ultimate claims for prior underwriting years (2016 & prior) moved adversely by $0.6m (strengthening). Management attributes this small overall prior-year deterioration to a mix of factors: a significant reduction in prior year premiums and offsetting underlying claims deterioration (notably within Professional Indemnity), together with adverse experience in Aviation, Accident & Health and Aon Client Treaty, partially offset by favourable development in Technical risks. No large named catastrophe event is cited as the driver of the prior year movement and line-specific quantified reserve changes are not provided.

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the Syndicate's presentation currency USD. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the technical provisions reconciliation (Gross provision for claims brought forward = 648,329 $000 on page 34). Prior year development (gross) of +$0.6m was taken from the narrative 'Claims Split by Reporting Year of Account' (page 41) which explicitly states gross and net movements. Line-of-business level reserve movements are described qualitatively in the narrative but not quantified; where quantified gross movements were not provided, amounts are null. Page numbers are taken from the report's page headers and may be off by +/-1 depending on indexing in the source PDF.
